purpose: DynamicPET is a C++ loadable module bundle for dynamic PET analysis in 3D Slicer. It extracts time-activity curves from segmentations, fits kinetic models (Patlak, Logan, compartment models) per ROI or per voxel, and creates parametric images. It also bundles a dynamic PET DICOM importer and a dynamic RTSTRUCT importer.
summary: I reviewed the top-level CMake files, the module, watcher and worker sources, the logic header, and the README. I searched the two very large .cxx files with targeted greps instead of reading them in full. I found no malicious behaviour, network access or data exfiltration. Excel dependencies are installed only after a confirmation prompt. highdicom is pip-installed without any prompt when a Parametric Map export is first used. The module still carries template placeholder metadata ("John Doe", category "Examples", an NIH grant placeholder). Most of the code lives in three git submodules that I could not inspect, and the scm_revision "5.12" could not be resolved. The MIT license is present. The verdict is minor issues, but the review is incomplete for the submodule code.
